summary: Lock chapter-by-chapter audit and revision workflow.
changed: Work on one chapter at a time.
For each chapter, first perform a full audit without rewriting.
After the audit, execute the approved revision in the separate copyediting workspace.
Before starting the next chapter, reread and keep in view how the previous chapter ends.
Audit each chapter not only internally but also for continuity, rhythm, causality and transition from the previous chapter into the next.
Do not remove important events merely to improve elegance or compression.
Preserve chronology, source truth, character initiative provenance and the core theme: radical difference without loss of closeness.
next_action: Begin with Chapter 1 audit only; do not rewrite until audit is complete.
